# Warlock AI Workspace

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai-workspace`

> Policy-jailed filesystem + shell workspace for @warlock.js/ai agents

## Skills

- [build-loop-agent](@warlock.js/ai-workspace/build-loop-agent/SKILL.md): Build a build-loop agent — read → edit → run tests, until green in @warlock.js/ai-workspace; use when you need to build loop agent.
- [use-a-workspace](@warlock.js/ai-workspace/use-a-workspace/SKILL.md): Use a workspace — a policy jail for an agent's filesystem + shell in @warlock.js/ai-workspace; use when you need to use a workspace.
